name: Responses API — Inline moderation
summary: Nested `moderation.model` field on POST /v1/responses (and POST /v1/chat/completions) that runs a separate moderation model alongside the main generation.
description: Responses inline moderation is OpenAI's nested `moderation` request object for running a separate moderation model, such as `omni-moderation-latest`, alongside the main generation. It solves same-call policy screening; Azure Foundry instead applies its own server-side content filtering layer.
notes:
Not supported: the server accepted the request but returned `moderation=None`, so the OpenAI-only moderation model was not honored. See `test.py`.

> responses.create moderation OK: status='completed', moderation=None, output_text='Hi there!'
